title: Father & Son in Meadow Field, Summer Sun - Vintage 1940s Sepia Snapshot Photo
description: A smiling, shirtless father wearing round glasses poses while crouched in an open sunlit grassy field, holding his young son who is dressed in a striped tee and dungarees. Other young children and distant figures linger across the wide meadow behind them, capturing a candid scene of post-war domestic family leisure on a warm summer afternoon. The back features a photofinisher reference code '290 R' alongside corrugated storage offsetting.
